name: execute_code
description: Run Python, JavaScript or TypeScript in a sandboxed AgentCore Code Interpreter session. State persists across calls, so variables and imports from earlier calls stay available. Each user gets their own isolated sandbox automatically. Returns stdout, stderr and the exit code.

language.description: One of: python, javascript, typescript. Defaults to python.

clear_context.description: Set true to discard variables from earlier calls before running.

name: execute_command
description: Run a shell command inside the sandboxed Code Interpreter session, for example 'pip install pandas' or 'ls -la'. Shares its filesystem with execute_code in the same session.

name: write_files
description: Create or overwrite text files in the Code Interpreter sandbox filesystem, so later execute_code or execute_command calls in the same session can read them.

name: read_files
description: Read files back from the Code Interpreter sandbox filesystem, for example an output file a script just produced.

name: list_files
description: List the contents of a directory in the Code Interpreter sandbox filesystem.

path.description: Directory to list. Defaults to the working directory.

name: remove_files
description: Delete files from the Code Interpreter sandbox filesystem.

name: stop_code_session
description: Shut down your Code Interpreter session and discard its state. Sessions also expire on their own, so this is only needed to free one early or to start from a clean slate.

inputSchema.description: No arguments; your own session is used.

name: browser_navigate
description: Open a URL in a managed AgentCore Browser session. Call browser_screenshot afterwards to see the rendered page. The browser keeps its page, cookies and history across calls with the same 'session'.

name: browser_screenshot
description: Capture what the browser session currently shows. Returns a temporary https URL to a PNG image; fetch or view that URL to read the page. Use this after navigating, clicking or typing to see the result.

name: browser_click
description: Click at pixel coordinates in the browser session. Take a screenshot first to find what to click.

button.description: LEFT, RIGHT or MIDDLE. Defaults to LEFT.

click_count.description: Number of clicks, 1-10. Use 2 to double-click. Defaults to 1.

name: browser_type
description: Type ASCII text into whatever is focused in the browser session, for example a form field that was just clicked.

name: browser_press
description: Press a single key in the browser session, such as enter, tab, escape, backspace or an arrow key.

key.description: Lowercase key name, e.g. enter, tab, escape, space, backspace, delete.

presses.description: How many times to press it, 1-100. Defaults to 1.

name: browser_shortcut
description: Press a key combination in the browser session, e.g. ["ctrl", "t"] for a new tab or ["ctrl", "w"] to close one.

keys.description: Up to 5 lowercase key names pressed together.

name: browser_scroll
description: Scroll the browser page. By default scrolls down; pass a positive delta_y to scroll up.

x.description: Horizontal position to scroll at. Defaults to the viewport centre.

y.description: Vertical position to scroll at. Defaults to the viewport centre.

delta_y.description: Vertical scroll amount, -1000 to 1000. Negative scrolls down. Defaults to -300.

delta_x.description: Horizontal scroll amount, -1000 to 1000. Defaults to 0.

name: browser_stop
description: Close your browser session, discarding its tabs and cookies. Sessions also expire on their own.

inputSchema.description: No arguments; your own session is used.
